missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Энергия' is the feminine nominative subject. 'Солнечная' is the agreeing adjective, and 'полезна' is the short feminine predicate. A clean descriptive frame.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Энергию' is the accusative direct object of 'получают'. 'От солнца' is genitive of source, and 'растения' is the nominative plural subject. A useful science sentence.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Энергии' is genitive after 'нет' to express that he has none. 'Совсем' intensifies, and 'у него' frames the possessor. A common everyday complaint.
Strategic focus: Accusative with dative. 'Энергию' is the accusative object of 'даёт', while 'всему телу' is the dative recipient. 'Спорт' is the nominative subject. A natural health sentence.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of manner. 'Энергией' is instrumental after 'с' to describe how he works. 'Большой' agrees in the feminine instrumental. A vivid manner expression.
Strategic focus: Genitive after quantity. 'Энергии' is genitive after 'много' to express amount. 'В этой пище' is prepositional location. A useful nutrition pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об энергии' uses the prepositional form 'энергии' after 'об' to express the topic. 'Атомной' agrees in the feminine prepositional. A typical academic sentence.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Энергия' is the nominative subject of 'передаётся'. 'Эта' agrees, and 'по проводам' is dative plural of path. A clean technical sentence.
